title: Average Price Per Category
flavorText: GROUP BY with AVG — each group gets its own mean. A powerful way to compare categories at a glance.
narrative: Find the average price of products in each category to spot premium vs budget segments.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Datapad','Electronics',299.99,45),(2,'Power Cell','Electronics',19.99,200),(3,'Steel Cable','Hardware',8.50,500),(4,'Logic Board','Electronics',89.99,30),(5,'Ceramic Fuse','Hardware',2.25,1000),(6,'Optic Lens','Optics',149.99,15),(7,'Servo Motor','Robotics',55.00,80),(8,'Pressure Valve','Hardware',12.75,300);
task: Find the average price of products in each category. Order by avg_price descending.

hints.text: Use AVG(price) together with GROUP BY category.
SELECT category, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
SELECT category, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
